roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role is essential for maintaining high standards of care and ensuring a safe environment for both residents and staff.

In this dual capacity, you will be responsible for coordinating staff education and development programs, ensuring our team is equipped with the latest knowledge and skills. Additionally, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, implementing best practices to safeguard against healthcare-associated infections. This position offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on quality of care and staff competency.

We offer competitive compensation for this full-time opportunity. If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and infection control, we encourage you to apply and become a key part of our compassionate team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations pertaining to long-term care
